This 2019 GMC Sierra 1500 SLE 4x4 is equipped with a 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, delivering a full-size pickup configuration designed for towing capability, everyday driving, and all-weather performance. The GMC Infotainment System with an 8-inch touchscreen integrates Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, and voice command, supported by a multi-speaker audio system.

This 2019 Ford F-350 Super Duty Lariat Crew Cab is built to handle serious work while delivering a premium, high-tech driving experience. Adaptive Cruise Control with Collision Warning and Brake Support helps take the stress out of long highway miles, while Lane Keep Assist and the Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert add confidence in busy traffic or tight jobsite conditions. Outside, the chrome package, 20-inch chrome aluminum wheels, and LT275/65R20E OWL all-terrain tires give it a bold stance, complemented by 6-inch chrome tubular running boards. The 8-foot long bed is enhanced with LED box lighting, the LED lighting package, and a tailgate step, and the twin panel panoramic moonroof (panoramic sunroof) brings open-air comfort to every drive.
